booking.howItWorks: Fill in the event form with your name, contact details, event type, guest count (1 to 300) and date, and the Office Golf team gets back to you. You can also call (952) 324-5236.

packages.name: Hourly Simulator Rental
packages.description: TrackMan iO golf simulator rental by the hour. $39 per hour Monday–Wednesday, $59 per hour Thursday–Sunday.

faq.q: How many guests can you host for an event?
faq.a: Office Golf features a dynamic facility designed to captivate and energize groups of up to 300 guests.

faq.q: What kinds of events do you host?
faq.a: Corporate gatherings, holiday parties, senior all-night parties, birthday bashes, bachelor or bachelorette parties, baby or bridal showers, rehearsal dinners and more.
